name: look_at_camera
description: Look through the customer's live phone camera. Use whenever you need to see the equipment, read a nameplate, check wiring, lights or a meter, or confirm the customer did a step. Ask the customer to hold the camera steady on the thing first.
execution_message_description: Tell the customer you're taking a look, e.g. 'Hold that steady, let me take a look.'

question.description: What you want to find out from the image, e.g. 'What does the motor nameplate say?'

name: show_visual
description: Show a diagram, photo, video or web page on the customer's screen over their camera view. Prefer media_id from the catalog: {{media_catalog}}

media_id.description: ID of an item from the media catalog.

url.description: An https URL on an approved site, only if nothing in the catalog fits.

caption.description: One short line telling the customer what to look at.

name: clear_visual
description: Remove whatever you showed so the customer sees their live camera again.
